## ChatGPT

[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins)

1. **Create an MCP plugin** — Open the plugin directory → Add → Add custom MCP server. Enter the connection details below. Advanced OAuth settings are discovered automatically. Review the notices and choose “Create as a plugin”.
2. **Install & sign in** — Install Backlane from your personal plugins and complete sign-in with your Backlane account.
3. **Select it in chat** — Start a new chat, select Backlane with @ and ask which marketplaces you have connected.

**Connection details**

```text
Name: backlane
Description: Marketplace APIs (orders, offers, inventory)
Connection (Server URL): https://app.getbacklane.com/mcp
Authentication: OAuth
```

[Official instructions](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/custom-mcp-server)

## Check the connection

> Which marketplaces have I connected to Backlane?

Ask your AI assistant to call Backlane's list_integrations tool. A successful tool call confirms the MCP connection. An empty connection list means a marketplace still needs connecting; it is not an MCP connection failure.
